No
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No 272
Date 22/4/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
April 22nd 1916

Sir,
It is reported that the rebels in Shanghai
are now divided into three parties viz, Ghoong Woo
Ching 共和軍 Woo Koh Ching 護國軍 Tsoong Wco Koh Ming
Ching 中華民國軍。 Wong Ih Eon 黃一殿 son of Hsang Hsin
is leader of the first named organisation.
Myeu Tih Sung 鈕鉄生 is leader of the second and Chen
Chi Mei 陳其美 of the last named. The headquarters
of all these parties are said to be in the western
part of Frenchtown.
It is reported that the rebels here have sent a
man named Tsaung Ming Kwung 庄銘坤 to Soochow which
according to rebel reports will declare independence
soon. The rebels have also sent a man named
Tsu Tsung Hai to Yangchow, which is also expected to
break off relations with Peking in the near future.
It is reported that the rebels are trying
to arrange to get warships from Canton to attack
Woosung forts. Kiangyin will be used as a base
for the operations.
It is reported that Fokienese sugar merchants
in Shanghai have contributed a big sum of money
to the rebel funds.
In addition to the places in Pao Kong Li 宝康里
the rebels have now new meeting places at No.84 and 8
Shing Yih Li 新億里 Avenue Joffre Frenchtown.

Your Obedient Servant,
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

E udieson mrd Apr. 22.

编号
刑事侦缉处
情报登记处
第 272 号
日期 1916年4月22日
上海工部局。
（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股。）
1916年4月22日

先生，
据报，上海的叛军目前分为三派，即：共和军、护国军、中华民国军。黄一殿（Wong Ih Eon），系项馨（Hsang Hsin，音译）之子，为第一派组织的领袖。钮铁生（Myeu Tih Sung）为第二派的领袖，陈其美（Chen Chi Mei）为最后一派的领袖。据说所有这些派别的总部均位于法租界西部。
据报，此地的叛军已派遣一名名为庄铭坤（Tsaung Ming Kwung）的人前往苏州，据叛军方面消息，苏州即将宣布独立。叛军还派遣了一名名为朱宗海（Tsu Tsung Hai，音译）的人前往扬州，预计该地不久也将与北京断绝关系。
据报，叛军正试图安排从广州调遣军舰来攻击吴淞炮台。江阴将被用作行动基地。
据报，在上海的福建籍糖商已向叛军基金捐赠了一大笔款项。
除了在宝康里的据点外，叛军目前在法租界霞飞路新亿里84号和8号也设立了新的集会地点。

您顺从的仆人，
总探长。

警察总监上尉。

E udieson mrd 4月22日。
